presentation.description: Describe what you want to build, in plain words, and the engine helps you write it down clearly — laying out the pieces, walking you through each one, and checking that nothing is missing or malformed — then keeps it as readable files in your own project and settles it as the description to build from, once you've accepted it — and, when you're ready, turns it into a tracked build order and a list of things to build that a build can pick up. It checks that your description is complete and well-formed, never whether the idea itself is a good one — that stays your call. You choose how much detail to capture, nothing is treated as settled without your say-so, and a settled description can be changed or reopened later — the engine just asks you to confirm the change on the pull request first, so it is never a quiet edit. Optional, and removable anytime.
presentation.setup_trigger: describe and settle what to build
